Hi Olivia —

Thanks again for agreeing to onboard with Redwood. To keep Procurement & Finance moving, can you confirm a few items so we can generate POs and process payments smoothly? We typically try to collect these up front: 

- Preferred payment method (ACH domestic, wire, or international ACH). If wire, please include SWIFT/IBAN + intermediary bank details.
- Exact remittance email address for invoice receipts (where we should send remittance notifications).
- Invoice submission method: email to AP inbox, vendor portal, or upload to supplier portal? Any required invoice subject format (e.g., include PO#).
- Payment terms you typically accept (Net30, Net45, etc.). Redwood standard is Net30 unless otherwise negotiated.
- Tax form: please attach a W-9 (for US entities) — you can reply with a PDF or complete the form attached.

I attached our Vendor_BANK_SETUP_Form_v2.xlsx — if you can populate pages 1 and 2 with banking + remittance info and return it, Procurement will route to Finance. If you'd prefer DocuSign, we can send that link.

Short timeline: if we get the bank info and W-9 by Wednesday (3/31), we can issue the PO and aim for first payment on the next cycle (mid-April).

Would you be available for a 20-minute call tomorrow morning to run through the form? If so, send a preferred time.

Thanks,
Jonas Weber
Account Executive — Strategic Sales
Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwood.com

On Tue, Mar 30, 2026 at 10:18 AM Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com> wrote:
> - Marissa: can you confirm whether Redwood requires a signed vendor agreement before issuing the first PO for a small supplier like Orchard? If yes, we'll route to Legal.

Thanks for the ping. Quick answer: for vendors under $50k annual run rate we can issue a PO with a standard vendor onboarding packet (W-9, bank form, insurance certificate if applicable) and a one-page supplier terms addendum. No formal Legal SOW required unless the vendor will handle customer data or the expected spend exceeds $50k in 12 months. 

Action items for Procurement (Marissa):
- Create vendor record after receiving the completed bank form and W-9.
- Attach W-9 and bank form to the profile.
- Set "invoice_requires_po" flag to true and add instructions: "Include PO# in invoice subject; remit to ap@orchardsupplies.com".
- Notify AP to expect first invoice once PO issued.

Priyom, please confirm you can set Net30 and flag remittance email in the system. Once done I will approve and Jonas can publish the PO.

Marissa Cole

I completed the vendor setup in the ERP this afternoon. Summary below: 

- Vendor record created: Orchard Supplies, Inc. (Tax ID on W-9 matched).
- Bank info uploaded to secure vault (no banking details in clear text on the vendor profile).
- Invoice requirements: must include PO# in the subject line; invoices should be emailed to ap@orchardsupplies.com.
- Payment terms: Net30 (first payment cycle mid-April).
